question: Which bowler has the lowest bowling average per wicket taken?
sql:
-- Final check: all bowlers with 0 bowling average (0 runs conceded, at least 1 wicket)
WITH runs_conceded AS (
    SELECT b.bowler, SUM(bs.runs_scored) as total_runs
    FROM batsman_scored bs
    JOIN ball_by_ball b ON bs.match_id = b.match_id AND bs.over_id = b.over_id AND bs.ball_id = b.ball_id AND bs.innings_no = b.innings_no
    GROUP BY b.bowler
),
extras_conceded AS (
    SELECT b.bowler, SUM(e.extra_runs) as total_extras
    FROM extra_runs e
    JOIN ball_by_ball b ON e.match_id = b.match_id AND e.over_id = b.over_id AND e.ball_id = b.ball_id AND e.innings_no = b.innings_no
    GROUP BY b.bowler
),
wickets_taken AS (
    SELECT b.bowler, COUNT(*) as total_wickets
    FROM wicket_taken w
    JOIN ball_by_ball b ON w.match_id = b.match_id AND w.over_id = b.over_id AND w.ball_id = b.ball_id AND w.innings_no = b.innings_no
    GROUP BY b.bowler
)
SELECT 
    p.player_name,
    rc.total_runs,
    COALESCE(ec.total_extras, 0) as total_extras,
    rc.total_runs + COALESCE(ec.total_extras, 0) as total_runs_conceded,
    wt.total_wickets
FROM runs_conceded rc
JOIN wickets_taken wt ON rc.bowler = wt.bowler
LEFT JOIN extras_conceded ec ON rc.bowler = ec.bowler
JOIN player p ON rc.bowler = p.player_id
WHERE (rc.total_runs + COALESCE(ec.total_extras, 0)) = 0 AND wt.total_wickets > 0

function.name: run_sql_query
function.arguments:
{"sql": "-- Calculate runs conceded and wickets per bowler
WITH runs_conceded AS (
    SELECT b.bowler, SUM(bs.runs_scored) as total_runs
    FROM batsman_scored bs
    JOIN ball_by_ball b ON bs.match_id = b.match_id AND bs.over_id = b.over_id AND bs.ball_id = b.ball_id AND bs.innings_no = b.innings_no
    GROUP BY b.bowler
),
extras_conceded AS (
    SELECT b.bowler, SUM(e.extra_runs) as total_extras
    FROM extra_runs e
    JOIN ball_by_ball b ON e.match_id = b.match_id AND e.over_id = b.over_id AND e.ball_id = b.ball_id AND e.innings_no = b.innings_no
    GROUP BY b.bowler
),
wickets_taken AS (
    SELECT b.bowler, COUNT(*) as total_wickets
    FROM wicket_taken w
    JOIN ball_by_ball b ON w.match_id = b.match_id AND w.over_id = b.over_id AND w.ball_id = b.ball_id AND w.innings_no = b.innings_no
    GROUP BY b.bowler
)
SELECT 
    p.player_name,
    rc.total_runs,
    COALESCE(ec.total_extras, 0) as total_extras,
    rc.total_runs + COALESCE(ec.total_extras, 0) as total_runs_conceded,
    wt.total_wickets,
    CASE WHEN wt.total_wickets > 0 
        THEN ROUND((1.0 * (rc.total_runs + COALESCE(ec.total_extras, 0))) / wt.total_wickets, 2)
        ELSE NULL 
    END as bowling_average
FROM runs_conceded rc
JOIN wickets_taken wt ON rc.bowler = wt.bowler
LEFT JOIN extras_conceded ec ON rc.bowler = ec.bowler
JOIN player p ON rc.bowler = p.player_id
ORDER BY bowling_average ASC
LIMIT 20", "preview_rows": 20}
